data.long_meaning: Derived from Old German words ‘er’ meaning ‘earth’ and ‘rit’ meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘rich’. This name signifies a woman who is deeply connected to the earth and its abundance. The name Erdrich carries the meaning “Rich in earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erdrich usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
